mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) as total_agents, COUNT(DISTINCT salesman_id) as total_salesmen, COALESCE(SUM(total_charge_amount), 0) as total_charge_amount, COALESCE(SUM(total_withdraw_amount), 0) as total_withdraw_amount, COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) as total_net_amount, COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) as total_commission_amount, COALESCE(SUM(user_count), 0) as total_users FROM tb_agent_commission_stats WHERE statistics_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
